title: Peru's Andes: Unit Review
goal: Review the Cordillera Blanca, Caral and Chavín, the Inca empire, Cusco painting and Quechua, with the grammar you used to talk about them.
grammar: review: cleft sentences, antes de que, the se passive, stance adverbs, reporting verbs

items: I can review what I learned about the Peruvian Andes, from the glaciers to Quechua.
I can use cleft sentences, *antes de que* and *después de que*, the *se* passive, stance adverbs and reporting verbs.
I can put events from five thousand years ago to 1970 in order.
I can say who says what when a matter is disputed.
I can put one idea in the spotlight with a cleft sentence (*Lo que..., Fue en... cuando...*) (review).
I can order events with *antes de que* and *después de que* and the right mood (review).
I can say what was built or used with the passive *se*.
I can show my attitude to a fact with stance adverbs.
I can report what experts say with reporting verbs (*señalar*, *afirmar*, *recordar*, *negar*).
